decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from chronotope/chrono PR #1798, merged 2026-06-22T11:30:17Z. Labeled decontaminated: true because the fix post-dates the May 2026 training cutoff of the models this suite targets (Claude Opus 5); re-check `upstream_merged` against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. OffsetFormat::format rounds an offset's seconds to the nearest minute before printing at minute precision, so a FixedOffset from 23:59:30 through its 23:59:59 maximum rounded to 1440 minutes and printed as '+24:00'; offset hours are only valid as 00-23, so DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339 rejected chrono's own output with OutOfRange. The one-line fix in src/format/formatting.rs clamps the rounded minute count to 24*60-1. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (a71c212c), trimmed to the library plus its single required dependency num-traits; all optional deps (serde, rkyv, pure-rust-locales, defmt, iana-time-zone, wasm-bindgen, js-sys, windows-link) and all dev-dependencies are dropped, and the crate is built with default-features=false plus std. num-traits and its autocfg build dependency are vendored into repo/vendor with a .cargo/config.toml replace-source stanza; verified fully offline with `docker run --network none ... cargo build --offline` (448K vendor tree). MIT/Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt preserved. Coverage: 6 fail_to_pass tests, each verified to fail at the base commit and pass after the gold patch, spanning %z, %:z, the bottom of the rounding window (23:59:30), a negative offset, an RFC 3339 format-then-reparse round trip, and RFC 2822. The 4 pass_to_pass regression guards assert only whole-minute offsets, UTC, an ordinary round trip, and 23:59:29 (which rounds down and never reached the roll-over path), so they compile and pass at the base commit without referencing the clamp. NOTE: the upstream PR description also lists the Display impl of DateTime<FixedOffset> as an affected path, but that was not reproducible -- Display renders offsets at second precision ('+23:59:59') and so never takes the minute-rounding branch. A Display-based test was written, observed to fail both pre- and post-patch, and removed; do not re-add one. All expected constants are generated from the gold patch, and every assertion goes through public API (format, to_rfc3339, to_rfc2822, parse_from_rfc3339) rather than the pub-but-low-level OffsetFormat type the upstream test uses.
